_comment: Copy this file to notify-config.json (no .example) and fill in the real values. notify-config.json is gitignored (covered by 'scripts/automation/*.json' in .gitignore) — it never gets committed. Do not put real credentials in this .example file.
senderAppPassword: 16-character Gmail app password goes here — see myaccount.google.com/apppasswords. Not your regular Gmail password.
